description: A condition that causes brief episodes of dizziness or a spinning sensation, often triggered by changes in head position.
precautions: Move slowly when changing positions; avoid sudden head movements; maintain good hydration; seek medical evaluation for persistent or severe symptoms.

description: A condition caused by advanced HIV infection that severely affects the immune system.
precautions: Practice safe sex; do not share needles; follow prescribed medical treatment; attend regular medical checkups.

description: A common skin condition that causes pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, or inflamed skin lesions.
precautions: Keep skin clean; avoid excessive touching or squeezing; use non-comedogenic products; seek care for severe acne.

description: Inflammation and liver injury associated with excessive alcohol consumption.
precautions: Avoid alcohol; maintain a balanced diet; follow medical advice; seek evaluation for liver-related symptoms.

description: An immune system reaction to substances that are usually harmless, such as pollen, dust, foods, or certain medicines.
precautions: Avoid known triggers; keep surroundings clean; follow prescribed allergy treatment; seek emergency care for severe breathing difficulty.

description: A group of conditions involving joint inflammation, pain, stiffness, or reduced movement.
precautions: Maintain healthy weight; perform appropriate low-impact exercise; protect joints; follow medical treatment plans.

description: A respiratory condition involving airway inflammation and narrowing that can cause breathing difficulty, wheezing, or coughing.
precautions: Avoid known triggers; follow prescribed inhaler treatment; monitor symptoms; seek urgent care for severe breathing difficulty.

description: Age-related changes in the bones and discs of the neck that may cause neck pain or stiffness.
precautions: Maintain good posture; avoid prolonged neck strain; perform recommended exercises; seek evaluation for weakness or numbness.

description: A contagious viral infection that commonly causes an itchy rash and fluid-filled blisters.
precautions: Avoid close contact with others while contagious; keep skin clean; avoid scratching; stay hydrated; seek medical advice for complications.

description: A condition involving reduced or impaired flow of bile from the liver, which may cause jaundice or itching.
precautions: Follow medical advice; avoid alcohol; maintain a balanced diet; seek evaluation for persistent jaundice or severe symptoms.

description: A common viral infection of the upper respiratory tract that may cause a runny nose, cough, sore throat, or congestion.
precautions: Rest adequately; drink fluids; maintain good hygiene; avoid unnecessary antibiotic use; seek care for persistent or severe symptoms.

description: A viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes that can cause fever, headache, muscle pain, and other symptoms.
precautions: Prevent mosquito bites; stay hydrated; monitor for warning signs; seek medical care for severe symptoms or bleeding.

description: A metabolic condition in which blood glucose levels remain elevated due to problems with insulin production or action.
precautions: Monitor blood glucose as advised; maintain a balanced diet; exercise appropriately; follow prescribed treatment.

description: Swollen veins in the lower rectum or anus that may cause discomfort, itching, or bleeding.
precautions: Increase dietary fiber; drink adequate fluids; avoid prolonged straining; seek medical evaluation for persistent bleeding.

description: An unwanted or harmful response to a medication that may range from mild skin reactions to serious allergic responses.
precautions: Do not take suspected medicines again without medical advice; inform healthcare providers about drug allergies; seek emergency help for breathing difficulty or swelling.

description: An infection caused by fungi that may affect the skin, nails, mouth, or other body areas.
precautions: Keep affected areas clean and dry; avoid sharing personal items; follow prescribed antifungal treatment; seek care for persistent infection.

description: A digestive condition in which stomach contents frequently flow back into the esophagus, causing symptoms such as heartburn or regurgitation.
precautions: Avoid large meals; limit personal trigger foods; avoid lying down immediately after eating; maintain a healthy weight.

description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines that may cause diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, or fever.
precautions: Stay hydrated; wash hands frequently; eat light foods as tolerated; seek care for severe dehydration or persistent symptoms.

description: A medical emergency caused by reduced or blocked blood flow to the heart muscle.
precautions: Seek emergency medical attention immediately for chest pain or severe breathing difficulty; manage cardiovascular risk factors with professional guidance.

description: A viral infection that affects the liver and may become chronic in some people.
precautions: Avoid sharing needles or personal items that may carry blood; practice safer sex; follow medical monitoring and treatment.

description: A viral infection that affects the liver and may cause chronic liver disease if untreated.
precautions: Avoid sharing needles or blood-contaminated items; follow medical evaluation and treatment; avoid alcohol if advised.

description: A liver infection caused by hepatitis D virus that occurs in people with hepatitis B infection.
precautions: Follow medical care; avoid sharing blood-contaminated items; practice safer sex; attend regular liver monitoring.

description: A viral infection that primarily affects the liver and is often associated with contaminated food or water.
precautions: Maintain good food and water hygiene; wash hands regularly; seek medical evaluation for jaundice or persistent symptoms.

description: A condition in which blood pressure remains consistently higher than the recommended range.
precautions: Monitor blood pressure; reduce excess salt intake; exercise appropriately; maintain a healthy weight; follow prescribed treatment.

description: A condition in which the thyroid gland produces excessive thyroid hormones, potentially causing increased heart rate, weight loss, or anxiety.
precautions: Follow medical evaluation; take prescribed medicines as directed; monitor symptoms; avoid self-medication.

description: A condition in which blood glucose levels become lower than normal and may cause sweating, shakiness, confusion, or weakness.
precautions: Monitor blood glucose when appropriate; follow prescribed diabetes treatment; carry a suitable source of fast-acting glucose if advised.

description: A condition in which the thyroid gland does not produce enough thyroid hormones, often causing fatigue, weight changes, or cold intolerance.
precautions: Follow prescribed thyroid treatment; attend regular monitoring; maintain a balanced diet; do not change medication dosage without medical advice.

description: A contagious bacterial skin infection that commonly causes sores or blisters, especially around the face and limbs.
precautions: Keep affected areas clean; avoid sharing towels or personal items; maintain hand hygiene; follow prescribed treatment.

description: A condition characterized by yellowing of the skin or eyes due to elevated bilirubin levels and often associated with liver or blood-related conditions.
precautions: Seek medical evaluation to identify the underlying cause; avoid alcohol unless medically cleared; follow recommended treatment.

description: A mosquito-borne infectious disease caused by parasites that can produce fever, chills, and other systemic symptoms.
precautions: Prevent mosquito bites; seek prompt medical evaluation for fever after travel to malaria-risk areas; complete prescribed treatment.

description: A neurological condition that can cause recurring headaches, often with nausea or sensitivity to light and sound.
precautions: Identify and avoid personal triggers; maintain regular sleep and hydration; follow prescribed treatment; seek care for unusual or severe headaches.

description: A degenerative joint condition involving breakdown of joint tissues that can cause pain and stiffness.
precautions: Maintain a healthy weight; perform appropriate low-impact exercise; protect joints; follow professional treatment recommendations.

description: Loss of movement or weakness that may occur following bleeding in the brain and requires urgent medical evaluation.
precautions: Seek emergency medical attention immediately for sudden weakness, facial drooping, speech difficulty, or other stroke-like symptoms.

description: An open sore that develops in the lining of the stomach or upper small intestine and may cause abdominal pain or bleeding.
precautions: Avoid unnecessary use of ulcer-triggering medicines; follow prescribed treatment; seek urgent care for vomiting blood or black stools.

description: An infection of the lungs that can cause cough, fever, chest discomfort, and breathing difficulty.
precautions: Seek medical evaluation for significant respiratory symptoms; rest and hydrate; follow prescribed treatment; seek urgent care for severe breathing difficulty.

description: A chronic inflammatory skin condition that causes areas of thickened, scaly, or irritated skin.
precautions: Keep skin moisturized; identify personal triggers; follow prescribed treatment; avoid scratching affected areas.

description: An infectious disease caused by bacteria that most commonly affects the lungs and may cause prolonged cough, fever, or weight loss.
precautions: Seek medical evaluation for persistent symptoms; follow prescribed treatment exactly; follow public health guidance regarding infectious disease precautions.

description: A bacterial infection commonly associated with contaminated food or water that may cause prolonged fever and digestive symptoms.
precautions: Maintain safe food and water practices; wash hands frequently; seek medical evaluation for persistent fever; complete prescribed treatment.

description: An infection affecting parts of the urinary system that may cause painful urination, frequent urination, or lower abdominal discomfort.
precautions: Stay hydrated; maintain good hygiene; seek medical evaluation for persistent symptoms, fever, or back pain; follow prescribed treatment.

description: Enlarged and twisted veins, commonly occurring in the legs, which may cause discomfort or swelling.
precautions: Avoid prolonged standing or sitting; exercise regularly; elevate legs when appropriate; seek medical evaluation for significant swelling or pain.

description: A viral liver infection commonly transmitted through contaminated food or water and often causing fatigue, nausea, or jaundice.
precautions: Maintain good hand and food hygiene; avoid contaminating food for others; seek medical evaluation for jaundice or persistent symptoms.
